items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: Well, he was the leader. And then I played bass, you know.

ctx.x: No, he wasn't too loud, but he could play good though. Yeah. And... Well, then they used... At Tom Anderson, they used two guitars, you see. Because they had more vocal. The fellas... There were two men in the band. Snow and this other fella, Charlie Washington. Them two fellas could sing. And this other fella, Tom Brown, who played the mandolin. He could play mandolin by note. But he read music. Yeah. Well, he was the leader. And then I played bass, you know. I'd taken Sam Orange's place on the bass. And I…

items.q: Tom Brown? Yeah yeah well I played with him.

ctx.x: Yeah. And where was his place?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: And I went with Charlie, with Tom Brown. We had Frank Keelan playing trumpet with us then.

ctx.x: What about Sam Moran? You remember him?

Sam, uh, Sam Moran was a bass player. Now, he played, he played X-ray with Tom Brown at, uh, at Tom Anderson. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. I, I, I believe I, I took, I took his place one time, and I remember the last, the last winding up of, of Tom Anderson, uh, Sam Moran got his, health got bad. And he's living on Gascon Street. And his health got bad, and they had to put me on the bass. Mm-hmm. And I went with Charlie, with Tom Brown. We had Frank Keelan playing trumpet with us then. Yeah. Frank Keelan. Frank Keelan. I'll…
Did they have, uh, two drummers in those times? I mean, before they had the foot pedal, do you remember them? Yeah. Tom Albert told me about it. They always had foot pedals?
